metadata.description: hack-vibe-x skills and hooks for Claude Code. Install only the plugins you want.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-visual-decision
plugins.description: Asks decisions in a local web page with visuals and clear differences, then records finished decisions as documents. Skill and hooks for Claude Code.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-criteria-gap
plugins.description: Records the judgement criteria you agree on with an AI, and finds where work was handed over without them. Skills and an opt-in hook.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-session-coach
plugins.description: Looks back on your AI work sessions: a daily diary written from yesterday's sessions, and a playbook of know-how pulled from sessions you pick.
